prompt:
Create one transparent-background sprite atlas in crisp pixel-art style. Use the provided source+six contact as the ONLY authority for identity, materials, palette, object count, layout, and source-supported landmarks. Row order: ghost-cemetery-temple-of-yemaya-shrine; ghost-havana-el-capitolio-entrance-facade; ghost-havana-old-havana-arcade-frontage. Each reference row shows the native source and current FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR views. The TOP/BOTTOM views are the targets to correct; preserve all approved source views as identity and physical-shape authority. Do not use isometric angles or copy a broad frontal face into the overhead plane.

Output exactly a 6-column x 3-row atlas with square cells, no labels or gutters, columns in this order: FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR; rows in the order above. Each object must be completely isolated, centered, unclipped, and surrounded by transparent padding. Strict axis-aligned orthographic views. Front/rear are broad elevations, right/left are edge elevations, TOP looks straight down along +Z and BOTTOM straight up along -Z. Keep view scale consistent within each object. The four existing non-target directions are context only; do not redesign their content. Generate coherent top/bottom geometry as inferred illustrations based on the accepted side thickness, native source layout, and occlusion.

Row 1 Yemaya shrine: preserve source blue-water-and-stone shrine identity and four gold corner caps with circular center. TOP is a shallow shrine/crown footprint with narrow rear shell rim, rear statue/head close to the back, forward semicircular basin and steps, side candles; do not lay the frontal radial shell ribs or full blue deity face into XY. BOTTOM is a narrow opaque stone support footprint corresponding to side thickness, with only structurally visible undersides; no frontal deity/water face, no broad square plate.

Row 2 El Capitolio entrance facade: source FRONT/REAR are broad facade elevations with a centered gold dome, palms at the sides, and long building face. TOP must be broad X and shallow Y: roof/cornice footprint with centered circular dome cap of source-supported diameter, and palms as small compact crown/end marks only. Do not lay the full frontal dome/wings into XY or invent a deep cross-building footprint. BOTTOM remains a narrow shallow underside consistent with retained source BOTTOM and side depth; no frontal facade in the underside. If this row is context-only for one target column, preserve plausible matching TOP/BOTTOM.

Row 3 Old Havana arcade frontage: preserve the source's long gold-and-teal multi-story facade, balcony and window count, and rooftop finials. TOP is a long-X shallow roof/coping plan matching retained side/BOTTOM depth; finials are compact overhead marks at their fixed positions. Do not make a broad square roof, full facade, or upright windows visible from above. BOTTOM is a thin support/stone underside matching the accepted base depth and source material, no frontal elevations.

Even though the atlas shows all six columns, final candidates will use only shrine TOP/BOTTOM and Capitolio/Arcade TOP. Maintain exact source-supported counts and landmarks. Use clean pixel-art contours, with no stray islands outside each complete silhouette.
